title: Gear Wardrobe
description: Adds a wardrobe to swap between armor sets/loadouts/gear/profiles with the click of a button!
body: Adds a simple to craft wardrobe that can be used to store armor for easy swapping. All you need to do is load your armor in the wardrobe, then press equip and it will swap your armor easily. This is a simple mod that I was suprised wasn't already made, so I made it myself.
